page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7a-nps1.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.55 GHz. The instance configuration provides 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled, delivering 32 dedicated vCPUs. Cache allocation includes 32 KB L1 data cache, 0.5 MB L2 cache per core, and 32 MB of shared L3 cache. It features standard x86 extensions such as AVX, AES, VAES, and SHA-NI, though it lacks AVX-512 and AMX instructions.

System memory totals 128.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 8 Gbps. There is no bundled local storage provided with this server type, requiring the provisioning of external networked block storage for operating systems and persistent data. Additionally, the instance contains no dedicated GPU hardware accelerators.

Benchmark measurements position the instance largely in the mid-range of general-purpose compute servers. The single-core stress-ng metric demonstrates strong performance in the upper quartile, alongside a strong PassMark memory score of 2,867.41. Most other evaluations, including Geekbench multi-core (11,247.0), PassMark CPU (36,056.93), and Clang software compilation, track within the middle 50% band. While cached small-block memory throughput reaches 2,056.31 GB/sec, large uncached block write bandwidth falls into the lower 25% bracket at 19.13 GB/sec.

Given its dedicated core allocation and balanced resource distribution, ecs.g7a-nps1.8xlarge offers solid qualitative resource efficiency for sustained middle-tier enterprise workloads. The hardware profile is aligned with multi-threaded application servers, container clusters, Redis caching layers, and relational database hosting dependent on remote cloud storage volumes.
